Comerica Park

Average HR Distance
398.2 ft
Exit Velo: 103.8 mph
``` ```{r} #| label: setup #| message: false #| warning: false #| echo: false library(tidyverse) library(jsonlite) library(plotly) # Load scraped park dimensions dataset parks <- fromJSON("data/park_dimensions_factors.json") |> as_tibble() # 2026 season data for macro plot parks_current <- parks |> filter(season == 2026, split == "All") fit <- lm(index_hr ~ avg_fence_distance, data = parks_current) r_val <- cor(parks_current$avg_fence_distance, parks_current$index_hr, use = "complete.obs") r2_val <- summary(fit)$r.squared # Load Statcast individual home runs dataset hr_data <- fromJSON("data/statcast_homeruns.json") |> as_tibble() max_dist <- max(hr_data$dist, na.rm = TRUE) min_dist <- min(hr_data$dist, na.rm = TRUE) max_ev <- max(hr_data$ev, na.rm = TRUE) avg_ev <- round(mean(hr_data$ev, na.rm = TRUE), 1) ``` ::: {.panel-tabset} Explore batted-ball exit velocities, launch angles, and distances across 3,500+ individual home runs tracked by Statcast. ```{=html}
Max HR Distance
`r max_dist` ft
Longest recorded blast
Shortest Wall-Scraper
`r min_dist` ft
Short-porch special
Max Exit Velocity
`r max_ev` mph
Hardest hit ball
Optimal Launch Angle
24° – 32°
Sweet spot for HR power
``` ::: {.glass-card} ### Exit Velocity vs. Hit Distance ```{r} #| label: plot-hr-scatter #| message: false #| warning: false #| echo: false p_hr <- plot_ly( data = hr_data, x = ~ev, y = ~dist, color = ~stand, colors = c("L" = "#38bdf8", "R" = "#f472b6"), type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~paste0( "", player, " (", stand, "HB)
", "Stadium: ", stadium, " (", team, ")
", "Date: ", date, "
", "Exit Velo: ", ev, " mph
", "Distance: ", dist, " ft
", "Launch Angle: ", la, "°
", "Pitch: ", pitch_speed, " mph
", "", des, "" ), hoverinfo = "text", marker = list( size = 6, opacity = 0.65 ) ) |> layout( title = list( text = "Exit Velocity vs. Hit Distance (Color by Batter Hand)", font = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 16) ), paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6)", xaxis = list( title = "Exit Velocity (mph)", gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)", color = "#94a3b8" ), yaxis = list( title = "Hit Distance (ft)", gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)", color = "#94a3b8" ), legend = list( font = list(color = "#e2e8f0"), title = list(text = "Batter Hand") ) ) p_hr ``` ::: ::: {.glass-card} ### Launch Angle vs. Exit Velocity ```{r} #| label: plot-launch-angle #| message: false #| warning: false #| echo: false p_la <- plot_ly( data = hr_data, x = ~la, y = ~ev, color = ~dist, colors = c("#38bdf8", "#f43f5e"), type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~paste0( "", player, "
", "Launch Angle: ", la, "°
", "Exit Velocity: ", ev, " mph
", "Distance: ", dist, " ft
", "Stadium: ", stadium ), hoverinfo = "text", marker = list( size = 6, opacity = 0.7, colorbar = list( title = list(text = "Distance (ft)", font = list(color = "#e2e8f0")), tickfont = list(color = "#e2e8f0") ) ) ) |> layout( title = list( text = "Launch Angle (°) vs. Exit Velocity (mph)", font = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 16) ), paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6)", xaxis = list( title = "Launch Angle (degrees)", gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)", color = "#94a3b8" ), yaxis = list( title = "Exit Velocity (mph)", gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)", color = "#94a3b8" ) ) p_la ``` ::: ## 🏟️ Ballpark Dimensions vs. HR Factor Explore how outfield fence distance, wall height, and stadium altitude govern home run rates across Major League Baseball. ::: {.glass-card} ```{r} #| label: plot-macro #| message: false #| warning: false #| echo: false p_macro <- plot_ly( data = parks_current, x = ~avg_fence_distance, y = ~index_hr, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~paste0( "", venue_name, " (", team, ")
", "City: ", city, "
", "HR Factor: ", index_hr, "
", "Avg Fence Dist: ", avg_fence_distance, " ft
", "Elevation: ", elevation, " ft" ), hoverinfo = "text", marker = list( size = 12, color = ~color, line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 1.5), opacity = 0.9 ) ) |> add_lines( x = ~avg_fence_distance, y = fitted(fit), line = list(color = "#3b82f6", width = 2.5, dash = "dash"), name = "OLS Trendline", hoverinfo = "none" ) |> layout( title = list( text = "Fence Distance vs. Home Run Park Factor (2026)", font = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 16) ), paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6)", xaxis = list( title = "Average Fence Distance (ft)", gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)", color = "#94a3b8" ), yaxis = list( title = "Home Run Factor (100 = MLB Average)", gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)", color = "#94a3b8" ), showlegend = FALSE ) p_macro ``` ::: ::: {.glass-card} ### Statistical Regression Summary - **Correlation Coefficient ($r$):** `r round(r_val, 3)` (moderate negative correlation) - **Coefficient of Determination ($R^2$):** `r round(r2_val, 3)` - **Regression Equation:** `r sprintf("HR Factor = %.2f * (Avg Fence Dist) + %.1f", coef(fit)[2], coef(fit)[1])` > **Key takeaway:** Shorter outfield fences strongly facilitate home run production. Each 1-foot decrease in average fence distance correlates with an increase in home run factor. ::: :::
